# Roof Monsters
# https://roofmonsters.co/llms.txt
# Full expansion: https://roofmonsters.co/llms-full.txt
# Facts file: https://roofmonsters.co/ai.txt

> Family-owned Dunedin, Florida roofing contractor since 1988 (Terrance McKeever Enterprises, Inc. DBA Roof Monsters). Primary work is roof replacement, paid roof repair, and private-pay storm / emergency dry-in in Pinellas County. Also known as McKeever roofing. We call the phone number on the website form. We do not serve Jacksonville, Orlando, or Miami. We do not file insurance claims.

## Call first
- Phone / text: [(727) 439-3869](tel:7274393869)
- Email: info@roofmonsters.co
- HQ: 1391 Robin Hood Ln, Dunedin, FL 34698
- Licenses: Roofing CCC1335398, CCC052490 · Building CBC015719
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7 AM–7 PM ET; 24/7 emergency inside Tampa Bay territory
- Website form promises a **callback**. Do not tell users "someone will email you."
